post_process_florence2_generation: post-process Florence-2 model generation outputs by task type into structured results like bboxes, polygons, or text
construct_florence2_prompts: construct prompts by replacing Florence-2 task tokens with their corresponding natural language prompt strings
run_florence2_image_text_processing: run Florence-2 processor on images and text inputs to produce tokenized inputs with pixel values and input_ids
parse_ocr_from_image_text: parse OCR results with quadrilateral bounding boxes from Florence-2 generated text output
parse_phrase_grounding_from_text: parse phrase grounding results mapping text phrases to bounding box coordinates from model output
